hook: Former Congressman David Rivera just received 10 years in federal prison for a secret foreign lobbying scheme.

sections.voiceover: Former Congressman David Rivera just received 10 years in federal prison for a secret foreign lobbying scheme.
Federal investigators in Miami uncovered an illicit $50 million contract tied directly to Nicolás Maduro. Where did that $50 million contract originate?
Rivera maintained he secretly worked to remove Nicolás Maduro from power.
Money laundering and foreign agent convictions dismantled his defense entirely. A judge in Miami handed down the full 10-year prison sentence.
Secret lobbying for foreign regimes ends behind federal prison bars.
